instruction: Copy to a new run and populate during execution; null means unrecorded, never infer missing historical timestamps or result counts.
rules: Record explicit empty/no-filter values when known; distinguish unknown from none.
If a service does not expose total result count, record unavailable and count only the returned/screened list.
Capture each actual screened URL and disposition; pagination/order differences can prevent exact search replay even with complete metadata.

For confirmatory exposure, commit the complete plan before execution and record a verifiable pre-execution freeze; prefer an independently timestamped immutable anchor. A local timestamp or post-execution push is insufficient evidence of independent timing.
Do not execute holdout or dependent confirmatory work before the required owner-approved D07/D08 experiment freeze.
